name: Fresh Fruits
description: Guidelines for traveling with fresh fruits in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Fresh fruits are allowed in both carry-on and checked bags for domestic flights. International flights have strict agricultural restrictions.
conditions: Must be consumed or discarded before customs if traveling internationally.
Liquid-like fruit purees or smoothies are restricted under liquids rules.

faq.question: Is fresh fruits allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Fresh Fruits is allowed in carry-on luggage. Fresh fruits are allowed in both carry-on and checked bags for domestic flights. International flights have strict agricultural restrictions.

faq.question: Can you pack fresh fruits in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Fresh Fruits is allowed in checked bags.
